product.olivetti-m64.summary: The mid-range upright Linea 1 system with 3000-format OLIBUS boards.
product.olivetti-m64.history: Olivetti placed the M64 in the upper middle of Linea 1 alongside the M70. The manual documents an M64 SP upgrade with a Motorola 68000 CPU.
product.olivetti-m64.architecture: Expansion used a common board format. The manual describes 3000-format OLIBUS and a 10 MHz processor.
product.olivetti-m64.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m64.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
